title: "Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions" on web when using the GH Action web templates vs the official templates
body: ### Tested versions using web template from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/30753732502?pr=122033 and my own fork web template (which I changed the scons args for) https://github.com/Goldenlion5648/godot/actions/runs/30773808503 Both of these templates were attempted to be used as the export target for both 4.8 dev 2 linux editor, and my editor fork ### System information Godot v4.8.dev2 - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 22 May 2026 19:25:09 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.0.9-arch2-1) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 28.18 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description It seems that when I use web templates generated by GH Actions, the web version does not work properly in the browser, giving the error `Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions` This occurs with both one of the latest generated templates https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/30753732502?pr=122033 and from my private fork which is primarily based on 4.7.1 https://github.com/Goldenlion5648/godot/actions/runs/30773808503 Both of these give the same error, but when I use the official web template (from the godot website for either 4.8 dev2 or 4.7.1), then the game works without issue. (is this WASM 64 related?) If there is some obvious difference between the official ones and what comes from github actions, let me know. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Download a web template from the godot repo github action 2. Export a project this template (my understanding is that the zip inside the downloaded zip is what needs to be used) 3. Upload to itch io 4. Gets error `Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions` ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) This project is just a 2D node with a rich text label, so seems to work with any [web_big_int_error.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30642442/web_big_int_error.zip)
